system.description:
Self; ritual.

  • Ask one question about a specific goal, event or course of action within the next 7 days.
  • You receive a short, truthful answer: a phrase, rhyme or omen that points the way, as cryptic as the GM wishes.
  • The answer is true 70% plus 1% per level (maximum 95%); otherwise you receive nothing.
  • Casting again on the same subject gives no new answer.
  • Material: incense and a sacrifice worth 25 sp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric, Paladin, Witch
